_readme: Copy to customer.config.json (git-ignored) to brand the lab. Only these four cast values are read; everything else is ignored. They fill the {{castBrand}}/{{castAgentId}}/{{castClientId}}/{{castHost}} tokens in the page text (brand: display name; agentId/clientId/host: lowercase letters, digits and dashes; host names the example agent host, kept off real networks by the reserved-host scan). Overrides the airlines (default), retail, health and finance vertical values.
